title: TAMIU Lights Its Christmas Tree Tonight, 6 to 8 PM
excerpt: Texas A&M International University celebrates the holiday season with its annual tree lighting ceremony tonight, Thursday, Nov. 19, from 6 to 8 p.m. on the Sue and Radcliffe Killam Library front lawn, free and open to the community, with a visit from Santa Claus.
content:
Texas A&M International University celebrates the holiday season with its annual tree lighting ceremony tonight, Thursday, Nov. 19, from 6 to 8 p.m. on the Sue and Radcliffe Killam Library front lawn, the university announced.

Admission is free and open to the community, and the evening marks the start of the holiday season at TAMIU, according to the university.

The ceremony includes a visit from Santa Claus, and children and their families are encouraged to visit and take photos with Santa, the university said. The evening also includes games and activities for families, free refreshments while supplies last and holiday-themed photo spots.

Students from Nye Elementary, Elias Herrera Middle School, United Day Cheer and the Col. Santos Benavides Cheer Team will perform music and dance sequences during the evening, according to the university.

The annual tree lighting is made possible through the support of Killam Development, with additional support from the university's Office of Housing and Residence Life, the university said. For more information, contact the TAMIU Office of Public Relations, Marketing and Information Services at prmis@tamiu.edu or 956-326-2180.

Sources: Texas A&M International University, Nov. 17, 2026.
